name: MINION-S
description: Autonomous multi-agent robotics & AI task coordinator for hardware-in-the-loop workflows.
whatItDoes: A distributed task coordination framework designed for robotics and autonomous AI agents. Manages telemetry feedback loops, synchronized multi-agent routines, state machines, and fail-safe recovery protocols for intelligent physical devices.

whatILearned.name: Robotics State Machine Coordination
whatILearned.description: Built hierarchical state machines preventing deadlock between cooperating autonomous agents.

whatILearned.name: Telemetry Streaming & Actuator Control
whatILearned.description: Implemented low-overhead binary serial and network streaming to physical microcontroller endpoints.

challenges: Handling sporadic packet loss over wireless robotics telemetry links without causing robotic actuator jerks.
Synchronizing multiple agent state clocks to prevent race conditions during physical object hand-offs.

nodes.label: Robotic Sensory Stream
nodes.tradeoff: High-frequency IMU, camera, and LIDAR packet ingestion.

nodes.label: MINION Orchestrator
nodes.tradeoff: Assigns atomic sub-tasks across available agent units.

nodes.label: Autonomous State Guard
nodes.tradeoff: Validates kinematic constraints before issuing motor commands.

nodes.label: MQTT Telemetry Bus
nodes.tradeoff: Lightweight broker with minimal RAM and CPU footprint.

nodes.label: Hardware Actuators
nodes.tradeoff: Physical robotic servos and motor drive controllers.

codeHighlights.explanation: Autonomous agent dispatcher verifying battery invariants and availability before task assignment.

name: trialsetu
description: Full-stack intelligent clinical trial management and patient eligibility platform with strict data validation.
whatItDoes: A secure, deterministic platform that connects clinical trial researchers with eligible participants. Features automated medical criterion matching, immutable consent logging, and end-to-end audit compliance for distributed healthcare trials.

whatILearned.name: Strict Invariant Type Systems
whatILearned.description: Designed comprehensive TypeScript schemas and Zod validators preventing data corruption.

whatILearned.name: Medical Criterion Filtering Engine
whatILearned.description: Architected multi-attribute search indexing across complex medical inclusion/exclusion rules.

challenges: Ensuring zero leakage of sensitive participant medical records through granular role-based access control (RBAC).
Designing complex nested criterion matching without degrading database query performance.

nodes.label: Patient & Doctor Portal
nodes.tradeoff: Responsive Next.js client with instant form validation.

nodes.label: Secure Auth Gateway
nodes.tradeoff: JWT + session verification guarding patient health records.

nodes.label: Eligibility Engine
nodes.tradeoff: Rule-based evaluator matching trials with candidate vitals.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Store
nodes.tradeoff: Append-only ledger guaranteeing regulatory compliance.

codeHighlights.explanation: Strict algebraic evaluation enforcing medical inclusion and exclusion invariants.

name: disaster-alert-system
description: AI-powered disaster alert system with NLP social media analysis for real-time emergency intelligence
whatItDoes: AI-driven emergency intelligence system that ingests crisis signals from live social streams and official sensor feeds, runs real-time NLP classification to detect urgency levels and extract geospatial coordinates, and pushes sub-second alerts to affected communities and response teams.

whatILearned.name: Real-time NLP Urgency Classification
whatILearned.description: Trained transformer models to filter noisy crisis tweets into validated high-priority danger alerts.

whatILearned.name: Geospatial Indexing & GeoJSON
whatILearned.description: Implemented bounding-box spatial queries to pinpoint hazard epicenters within meters.

whatILearned.name: Emergency WebSocket Fan-Out
whatILearned.description: Architected low-latency socket pipelines ensuring guaranteed packet broadcast during network congestion.

challenges: Eliminating false-positive crisis rumors by cross-validating multi-source social timestamps against verified weather sensors.
Maintaining stable sub-second WebSocket broadcast throughput during simulated spikes of 10,000 concurrent citizen clients.

nodes.label: Social & Sensor Streams
nodes.tradeoff: Polling & webhook web-crawlers ingest live emergency signals.

nodes.label: Ingestion Gateway
nodes.tradeoff: Rate-limits and deduplicates high-volume streaming data.

nodes.label: AI NLP Inference Engine
nodes.tradeoff: Classifies danger severity and extracts coordinates in <50ms.

nodes.label: Event Broadcast Bus
nodes.tradeoff: Dispatches critical alerts without blocking web servers.

nodes.label: Geo-Spatial Database
nodes.tradeoff: Indexed PostGIS tables for instant radius lookups.

nodes.label: Emergency Dashboard
nodes.tradeoff: Real-time interactive incident map with audio alerts.

codeHighlights.explanation: NLP evaluation threshold verifying high-confidence disaster signals prior to emergency broadcast.

name: ZenNews-

It features a smart dual-column layout that separates major world events from your local news, allowing you to instantly filter stories by your specific country and language
whatItDoes: ZenNews automatically gathers real-time headlines from trustworthy global sources into one clean, calm interface without the clutter of intrusive ads.
